Author: Mayo Botic, Ultranova Violet
Name: PF Analysis
Description: Manage your Party Finder recruitment and see who you are playing with. Save duty, objective, role and condition setups as presets and apply any of them in one click; watch your listing and party as it fills; and look up party members' progression and community ratings.
Punchline: Run your Party Finder: presets, party progression, and player lookups.
Changelog: Clears are announced on screen. When somebody clears an Ultimate or a savage fight, a banner says who cleared what, and you can heart it from there. It waits until you are out of a fight, never announces your own, and catches you up on what you missed when you log back in. Turn it off, move it or retime it in Settings. Installing the plugin now opens a proper setup screen rather than pages of text: three questions, applied as you answer them, then a look at what the plugin does. "Beginners welcome" is part of a preset now - saved, applied, and shown on the preset - where before, applying a preset cleared the tick off your listing. Savage clears are named after the boss rather than the floor. Sharing who is in your listing keeps working when PFRadar is installed; only the panel that reads other listings stands down. Fixed the party panel forgetting which duty you recruited for the moment the last seat filled, and the 99th and 100th percentile parse colours being hard to tell apart.
